title: m4 surfaceview gpu preview
tests: gate matrix without a device; 9 new tests pin the passing assembly,
description:
The M3 export gate, mirrored for the editor's preview, plus the trace
line's backend= field telling the two pipelines apart:

- GpuPreviewDevelop gains probe() and fragmentParity(fd): the capability
  probe and the case-0 fragment parity run (the developLinear shape the
  device PROVED at 1 LSB — the same case the M3 export gate rides), both
  submitted to the same single preview engine thread the CPU renders
  ride, BEFORE the session opens (the harness brings its own one-shot
  EGL context up and down inside the call; running the parity after the
  open would put two contexts on one thread). The parity leg dups the
  caller's fd natively; the screen's copy closes via closeFdQuietly.
- The session-open effect gates the open: only GPU_EXPERIMENTAL pays the
  probe, and the parity only when the probe's context + float-FBO gates
  are green AND the clip's fd opened (a doomed run is waste).
changed: feat: preview backend gate + trace honesty
